description: A line is the union, around the shared baseline, of the box of each run: a 40px span among 16px text under a 30px line-height makes a 39px line.

classification.reason: Measured against Chrome 155 on Windows: 3.46% of the pixels differ and the box matches exactly; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Before each run's line box was measured on its own, the same fixture measured 13.3% and the box is 9px short, so it fails.
